messages:
alice-support: FYI customer on 0.23.1 reporting 404s for `chat.create` and `summarize` endpoints after they upgraded. They see different param names in SDK vs API doc.

mike-eng: Can you paste the exact error and the payload they're sending? 404 usually means route mismatch not auth.

alice-support: Error snippet from their logs: 
```
Error: 404 Not Found: /v1/chat.create
    at fetch (/srv/app/node_modules/node-fetch/index.js:...)
    at Object.createChat (./src/client.ts:45)
```
They said they call `client.chat.create({session: 's1', model: 'redwood/fast', input: 'hi'})` and the SDK sends `session` but API expects `conversation_id` (older param was `session_id`).

anya-devex: :thinking: this sounds like the SDK got a param rename in the new API rollout and the TS types were bumped but runtime code didn't map aliases. Which exact SDK package version? 0.23.1? 0.22 had the old param names.

alice-support: They confirmed `@redwood/sdk` v0.23.1 and Node v18.14.0. They tried pinning to 0.22.7 and issue went away.

mike-eng: OK that nails it — compatibility regression in 0.23.x. Repro steps for eng: 
1) Install `@redwood/sdk@0.23.1`
2) `const c = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})`
3) `await c.chat.create({session: 'x', model: 'gpt-lite', input: 'hi'})` -> 404.

mike-eng: Quick patch: server expects `conversation_id` or `session_id`. SDK should map `session` -> `conversation_id` and keep backwards compat. I'll add a small middleware to map aliases until we cut a patch.

ryan-sre: Did the deploy bot pick anything up? Any rollout variant?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout v2026.03.12 -> canary -> 3/5 hosts (no obvious errors). No config drift detected.

anya-devex: For support reply: give customer a repro and workaround (pin 0.22.7 or call REST with correct param). Example REST call: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.create \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"conversation_id":"my-session","model":"gpt-lite","input":"hey"}'
```

alice-support: I'll respond: apologies, regression in 0.23.x — workaround: pin to 0.22.7 or use the curl body above. We are triaging and will push a patch.

mike-eng: I'll open a bug and PR to add param aliasing + unit test. Assign to @mike-eng. ETA for patch: ~2 business days. Will post back when npm release available.

anya-devex: Also add a brief note in the changelog and a temporary compatibility table in the docs so customers searching the SDK changelog see this.

alice-support: Customer replied: "Thanks — pinning worked, please let us know when fixed, we have a prod deploy tomorrow."

mike-eng: Prioritizing. Adding a log message in the SDK when unknown params are passed might help catch these quickly in future.

alice-support: Marking this as escalated for priority bugfix. I'll update the ticket when patch is released. :white_check_mark:
